optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Customer Operations Manager, Subscription Billing Platform

professionalSummary.text: Managed 31 consecutive monthly subscription billing runs from 2023, resolving production incidents and maintaining full operational ownership including pager duty and finance escalation.
professionalSummary.witness: Saw the subscription billing platform's monthly run through to completion in production for thirty-one runs in a row, holding the pager for the run and the finance escalation route from the first run of 2023.

experienceHighlights.text: Resolved critical incidents including the spring 2025 provider settlement outage, documented in operations incident tracker under candidate's name.
experienceHighlights.witness: Resolved the production incidents that delayed invoices or collections during those runs; the provider settlement outage of spring 2025 was the largest, and its record sits in the operations incident tracker under my name.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed pre-run change integration for engineering and finance, with reconciliation checks documented separately in change log.
experienceHighlights.witness: Took engineering and finance changes into production in the pre-run window before each run, with the change log marking my reconciliation checks separately from engineering's deployment checks.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained runbook and reported completion/error rates to finance after each run, with revisions following settlement outage and proration changes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reported completion and error rates to finance after each run and kept the billing runbook current, revising it after the settlement outage and after each proration rule change.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented platform limitations and handover conditions in post-run notes, specifically mid-cycle proration constraints.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the post-run notes and the incident notes, recording the platform's known limitations around mid-cycle proration and the conditions handed to whoever held the pager next.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided completion/error-rate reports for six runs, incident tracker record for settlement outage, and change logs for three pre-run windows as work samples.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the completion and error-rate reports for the last six runs, the operations incident tracker record for the settlement outage and the change log for the last three pre-run windows.

skills.text: Operational ownership of subscription billing platform runs, including incident resolution, change management, and reporting.
skills.witness: Saw the subscription billing platform's monthly run through to completion in production for thirty-one runs in a row, holding the pager for the run and the finance escalation route from the first run of 2023.
